patch.scope: Functionality only; no broad visual redesign.
changes: Nested SPA links now resolve back to the root application instead of remaining trapped under /media, /speaker, /blog or /create.
The Control palette opens only with Cmd/Ctrl+K; a plain K key no longer triggers it.
Locale and Companion persistence now degrade safely when localStorage is blocked or unavailable.
Escape closes the Companion dialog and restores the underlying page.
The Creator Path and archive routes use route-depth-aware relative navigation.
A five-scenario stateless QA suite was added for mobile entry, nested routing, keyboard behavior, dialog close and API fallback.

acceptance.qa_note: AppDeploy returned terminal e2e status passed. Its compact status payload displayed four passed jobs out of five total; no failed job or failure transcript was reported.

source_control.note: This receipt records the verified AppDeploy runtime patch. It does not claim the full v93 runtime source has been exported into GitHub main.
